title: A Dragon Ball Theme Park Is Coming to Paris
paragraphs: Fans of the Japanese manga and anime Dragon Ball may soon have a new place to visit in Europe. France and Saudi Arabia have agreed on a huge project to build theme parks near Paris, including one based on manga, which reports say will be themed on Dragon Ball.

The project was announced on August 24, 2026, during a visit to France by Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. He and French President Emmanuel Macron signed an agreement for the project. According to reports, it will cost about 6 billion euros.

The parks will be built in Cergy-Pontoise, an area about 30 kilometers northwest of Paris. The plan includes up to three theme parks, as well as hotels and other places for entertainment, culture and sports. One of the parks will be about manga, but the themes of the other two have not been announced. According to Macron, the project will create 22,000 jobs. "Nothing like this has been seen since Disneyland Paris," he said.

The project will be led by Qiddiya Investment Company, which is part of Saudi Arabia's government investment fund. Qiddiya is also building a Dragon Ball theme park near Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia. That park will have more than 30 attractions and a 70-meter-tall roller coaster.
According to Macron's advisers, the idea started in December 2024, when Macron and the crown prince met in Riyadh and found that they both love manga, especially Dragon Ball Z.

However, many details are not decided yet. The parks will be built in stages over several years, and no opening date has been announced. In addition, some reports say that the companies that own Dragon Ball have not yet agreed to the project. Some local politicians also worry that the new parks could take visitors away from Disneyland Paris.
